gameName: War of the Ring: Second Edition

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: War of the Ring rulebook (Ares Games, via Ultra Board Games)
War of the Ring multiplayer summary (via RulesPal)

steps.text: One player is the Free Peoples, the other the Shadow
Two per side: Gondor + Elves / Rohan + North + Dwarves; Witch-king / Saruman and allies; pass a Leading Player token each turn
One Free Peoples player against two Shadow players (Witch-king / Saruman and allies)
Board with room along the sides for discards, casualties and dice
Fellowship Progress counter on step 0, "Hidden" side up; Corruption counter on step 0
Companion cards in the Guide box with Gandalf the Grey on top; set aside Aragorn - Heir to Isildur, Gandalf the White and Gollum
Companion figures and counters in the Fellowship box; set aside the Gollum figure
3 Elven Ring counters in the Free Peoples' Elven Rings box, Ring side up
Set aside the Minion cards (Witch-king, Saruman, Mouth of Sauron) and their figures
Split each side's Event cards into Character and Strategy decks; shuffle separately onto their board areas
Beige Hunt tiles in an opaque cup (Hunt Pool); set aside the blue and red special tiles
Shadow takes {s} red Action dice, Free Peoples {f} blue; set aside the rest and the 5 Combat dice
Political counters: Free Peoples Passive side up except the Elves; Elves and all Shadow Nations Active side up
Top box: Rohan, North, Elves, Dwarves; second: Gondor and Southrons/Easterlings; third (above At War): Sauron and Isengard
Sort figures by color and type; place each Nation's starting Armies and Leaders per the Army Setup diagram; the rest are reinforcements
Keep reinforcements apart from eliminated figures
Phase 1: each player draws 1 card from each of their Event decks
